notes.title: Battle Titan RAINBOW – August Development Update
notes.notes:
📢 Battle Titan RAINBOW – 8.Development Update

Hello everyone, this is Pola. with another Bi-monthly Dev-Log.
As the game grows in scale, new challenges have appeared, but progress continues steadily.

[previewyoutube="nJg6s0ZnWtA;full"][/previewyoutube]
Development - video ( 3 m 30 s)  - Please raise the resolution to 1080p.
[hr][/hr]🚀 Major Updates


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/8687e6583fe0ad65dd3260763e9c94f767626421.jpg"]

BTR : Development Diary 21. - \[Details: English]

\[ A detailed development journal on the progress of the development. ]

DevDiaty_Link 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/5843bfcdd4ecfb2306c9718d5ba93ca288d0a29e.jpg"]


🏁 Final Stage Design Begins
Structured in 3 parts: Stratosphere Re-entry → Fortress Assault → Interior Battle

About 15 minutes of playtime, roughly double a normal stage

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/77ba1cdfe974ce52ffba0ba6e3234dc77f924e8d.jpg"]


🌵 Stage 5 Desert STAGE - Improvements
Added sandstorms, lighting effects, and atmosphere enhancements

Visual upgrades without disrupting game play



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/3eba74fc1984f489a48b38b151555a83f28ece94.jpg"]  


🎥 VFX & Camera Enhancements
Zoom blur, motion blur, and UI alpha blending

Retro shooter feel with modern cinematic effects



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/c45e8143f6cc2b71abe21f98a44538689bd2a1b4.jpg"]


🤖 Mecha - Artwork
Main robot design finalized

Unique mechanical art and high-quality sprite production underway



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/9f86f81bdbbf0ba7d2580e45a3871b49a30f1bf7.jpg"]


💥 Boss Bullet Patterns
Arcade Mode: Cave-style bullet-hell

Journey Mode: Retro shmup-style patterns



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/ab1d04fa0e5c9dfce2232f9535996cae1f7ddb3e.jpg"]


⚡ Combat Speed Improvements
Faster and expanded lock-on mechanics

Awakening Mode redesigned into a Mazinger Z-style booster combination



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/a82f1e011d560007197299323e7c04b70eac5ecd.jpg"]




🛡️ Additional Playable Units


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/5620e0ee05696af860a258d3b9249304b5b7018f.jpg"]

Unit 2: Lapis Lazuli & Ironwall Shiho → wide angle, slower speed, Thunder Roar special



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/2cf39dac4dce8b6a6fa512eacca36f1a87943a58.jpg"]

We have redesigned the prologue menu screen and adjusted the \[ Game UI]  layout to support multiple languages. Work has also begun on implementing the Gallery Mode.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/787dd4a1e8d3338c0c8a1f981f779c6b91de4913.jpg"]

notes.title: BattleTitan RAINBOW – Dev Update (May 2025)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/0f3e66b51fee5d1fd71b09faaf3e0aac52951804.png
BattleTitan RAINBOW – Dev Update (May 2025)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/e81f2f1fc42cbfb35504be453c8a58bd4bd486b0.jpg
Steam Deck Testing Initiated
CPU and GPU usage around 30%. Steam Deck surprisingly powerful, running smoother than low-end laptops with integrated GPUs.

Menu Development

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/71055c493e3f6597658a145b56bd508a053c7cad.jpg
A. Start Screen
Three types of start screens configured. Currently in development.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/d77c9a7d2ce55f43d4302143530ad0f50a03a877.jpg
B. Gallery Mode
Organized to allow browsing of characters, mechanics, and events from the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/2903202f86c25122b5a3cedaefce17f7fcafb79e.jpg
C. Ranking Screen
Currently, Demo doesn't support Steam leaderboards; local leaderboard operational.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/aa0c9ad4720395a9bd9d3dadd33accbe6859255f.jpg
D. Name Entry Screen
Allows players to change initials for leaderboard records. Designed with retro arcade game aesthetics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/229b596b749c8af83370d5203ca6a0685af16157.jpg
E. Input Key Configuration
Implemented customizable key mapping. The process was unexpectedly complex, highlighting why many indie games don't support this feature.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/fb7278017d1a8f4d6595d1104ccbac8d0efdfa14.jpg
Extra Language Support
Final language option [Extra] defaults to English, but players can modify CSV files to change languages freely.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/ee624d43a713d48de9fae920eb5d9a0cd17a8b1b.jpg


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/56b618860cd683f598c642d44344d99352377cb7.jpg

Event [Artwork] Development Ongoing

Developing the final Demo build during May
Includes Arcade 1, Story 1, and Boss Match 1 modes.

notes.title: Change game release date
notes.notes:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/0f3e66b51fee5d1fd71b09faaf3e0aac52951804.png

Hello, players.

I am a developer from Battle Titan Rainbow.

We have been working tirelessly on the development of the game, and as a result, we have made progress in the development of the Arcade mode, "Ashura Heaven Palace Fall," and the RPG mode, "강호행 (Gangho Journey)." We participated in the 2023 PlayX4 Indie Game B2B event held in South Korea and had the opportunity to connect with various publishers.

However, we have determined that we have not reached the desired level of game quality yet. Consequently, we have made the decision to postpone the release date from 2023.2Q to 2024.2Q.

To complete the RPG mode, "강호행 (Gangho Journey)," we realized that it requires much more development power than initially anticipated. Developing both modes to a satisfactory quality level would take a significant amount of time with our current resources.

Currently, our development team is focusing on completing the Arcade mode, "Ashura Heaven Palace Fall."

We apologize to all the players who were looking forward to the Early Access stage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/f3829e62d4878de05716006d3d9f1502c26b44a1.png
